calendar.title: Calendar completion
calendar.description: Choose your Google calendars and events for private completion reminders. Completing an occurrence never changes its future schedule.
calendar.connectionError: Google Calendar could not be connected or loaded. Try again.
calendar.connected: Google Calendar connected. Choose the calendars and events to follow below.
calendar.notConfigured: Google Calendar needs server configuration before you can connect. Manual schedules are available with /schedule add.
calendar.setup: Server setup: enable Google Calendar API, create a Web application OAuth client, register the dashboard URL followed by /api/auth/google-calendar/callback, then set GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_REDIRECT_URI and a random GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOKEN_ENC_KEY of at least 32 characters. Google may require OAuth consent-screen verification or a test-user entry.
calendar.filterHelp: Leave empty for every event. Otherwise only titles containing this text are imported. Choose up to 10 calendar/filter selections.
calendar.syncPending: Your selection is saved. The first sync is pending; it will retry automatically.
calendar.inactive: Paused; reselect or resume after connecting
calendar.historyHelp: Disconnecting or stopping a calendar preserves your completion history. Use /schedule history, /schedule summary and /schedule export in Discord to review or export it. Calendar access is read-only; reminders are private DMs. Past events imported initially do not send reminders.
